newsitem.title: ISRAEL: PLO licenses Hamas rally in sign of improved ties.
newsitem.headline: PLO licenses Hamas rally in sign of improved ties.

text.p: The Palestinian Authority has given the Hamas movement permission to hold a rally in the Gaza Strip on Friday to mark the Islamic group's ninth anniversary, a senior PLO official said on Sunday.

"They informed us in recent meetings that their position is to oppose the PLO-Israel peace accords in peaceful ways, and that they would not use violence," the official, who asked not to be identified, told Reuters.

Hamas officials said the self-rule Authority's decision to license the rally was a sign of goodwill following its crackdown on the group in the wake of Hamas suicide bombings that killed 59 people in Israel last February and March.
"The rally will be held on Friday, December 13, and we were given a licence to hold it by the Palestinian police, but we have held licenced rallies before," said Hamas leader Sayed Abu Musameh.
"There have been contacts between us and the Palestinian Authority and we are interested in having good relations with the Authority," he said.
